serving.notes: Returns LTE or NR5G-SA/NSA serving cell. Field order differs by RAT.

neighbor.notes: Returns intra-frequency and inter-frequency LTE neighbors.

full_scan.notes: Full band scan. Can take up to 2 minutes. Returns all visible cells with MCC/MNC.

plmn_scan.notes: 3GPP operator scan. 30-120 seconds. Returns operator names and RATs.

diag.port: QCDM/DM diagnostic on USB interface if00 (ttyUSB+0 in the runtime-default composition 0x0800: DIAG/NMEA/AT/AT/QMI/ADB). capture_cell_diag auto-detects it by matching the IMEI from an AT probe on a sibling port; diagport=<path> overrides.
diag.notes: SDX55 5G NR SA/NSA (sub-6). Full DIAG_TARGET_CODES set applies (capture_cell_diag/diag_config.c is the single source of truth): LTE ML1 serving 0xB193, LTE RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB0C0, LTE ML1 idle neighbors 0xB192, LTE ML1 connected neighbors 0xB195, LTE ML1 per-cell measurement 0xB17F (per-cell RSSI with RSRP/RSRQ), NR5G RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB821, NR5G ML1 measurement DB 0xB97F. interface=0 pins if00 (documented DIAG interface, README USB Interface Map) rather than the 'lowest ttyUSB' default. The 67 switchable compositions keep DIAG on if00; diagport= overrides for any non-default composition. GNSS position 0x1476 (LTE ML1 / gpsOne position report) and 0x14D8 (GNSS engine state) complete the set: the capture helper turns 0x1476 into a gps_fix and geo-tags every cell_observation from it. 0x14D8 is subscribed but yields no position (its parser hardcodes lat/lon/alt to 0.0 and no firmware populates those bytes), so it contributes engine state only. This list documents intent; the device decides what is actually subscribed, because diag_config_filter_supported narrows the shared set to each modem's advertised subset at handshake time. 0xB17F is emitted with version byte 5 while camped on LTE and not at all while camped on NR5G-SA. It is an LTE ML1 code, so an SA-camped unit emitting none is RAT state, not a missing capability. LTE ML1 serving cell information 0xB197 (per-cell DL bandwidth RB + Tx antenna ports) is emitted with version byte 2 after an AT+CFUN=4->1 re-camp with mode_pref pinned to LTE, and not during an idle window before it. Like 0xB17F it is an LTE ML1 code, so an SA-camped unit reading 0 is RAT state.
